mapper.select: select config_value from sys_config where config_key = #{configKey} limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_config set config_value = #{configValue}, update_by = #{username}, update_time = sysdate() where config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_config (config_name, config_key, config_value, config_type, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{configName}, #{configKey}, #{configValue}, 'N', #{username}, sysdate(), #{remark})
